label: conj:qou-motivic-galois-instance
title: QOU $\mathrm{MotivicGaloisCharacter}$ instance via Habiro $\to \mathrm{Frob}_p$
html:
QOU MotivicGaloisCharacter instance via Habiro evaluation

The QOU brane-tower substrate carries a concrete instance of Motivic Galois character \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A of the Frobenius--Hopf substrate constructed by the Habiro evaluation map:

  \mathrm{Frob}_p \;=\; f(u) \big|_{u = \zeta_{2p}}
  \;\in\; \mathbb{Z}[\zeta_{2p}].

Here f(u) = \sum_{m \geq 0} a_m(u) (u; u)_m represents the Habiro cyclotomic expansion of the atomic Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w, q) and u = q^{1/2}. The cyclotomic Pochhammer (u; u)_m vanishes for m \geq 2p. This forces the sum to terminate after a finite number of terms.

The finite-place compatibility checks, the downstream consumers, and cross-prime coherence are recorded in the follow-on remark; the per-cell \mathrm{Frob}_p data appears in the accompanying example.

Why this is stated as a conjecture. The formula above specifies \mathrm{Frob}_p in \mathbb{Z}[\zeta_{2p}], one prime at a time. What Motivic Galois character \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A of the Frobenius--Hopf substrate asks for is a single \mathrm{frobenius\_at} \colon \mathrm{Primes} \to \widehat{M}, so the content of the claim is that these per-prime evaluations cohere into one \widehat{M}-valued function. The follow-on remark argues that coherence structurally from the Habiro theorem; it is not proved. Calling this a definition would assert the construction was already in hand.

Status. No construction of this instance is available. The derivation of the perpetual obstruction from the prime-ideal collapse (C = a_0(-1) + 2 a_1(-1)) proves statements about the perpetual obstruction and constructs no motivic Galois character; it is a different result.
heading: Conjecture
